problem: OpenJDK source tree detected as generic
detector_change: Add structural OpenJDK markers before keyword scoring: src/jdk.compiler, src/java.base, src/hotspot, test/langtools and top-level make/.
acceptance: jdk-master scores Java/OpenJDK above every other profile.

problem: Java detector ignored overwhelming extension evidence
detector_change: Use extension density plus OpenJDK module topology; do not require a grammar-generator signature because javac parser is handwritten.
acceptance: Java detection remains high on full OpenJDK and compiler-only jdk.compiler subtrees.

problem: Grammar extraction has configuration false positives
detector_change: Only classify known parser grammar sources as grammar; .yml/.xml/build metadata must never become Java grammar rules.
acceptance: Grammar matrix exposes provenance/confidence and excludes CI/config formats.

problem: AST candidates mix Java source declarations with compiler AST node definitions
detector_change: Require javac tree/JCTree/Tree API or known generator paths for compiler AST; tag source declarations separately.

problem: HotSpot internals can swamp source-language semantics
matrix_evidence: OpenJDK includes JVM, GC and JIT implementation in same tree
detector_change: Separate semantic layers source_HIR / bytecode_MIR / VM_runtime / JIT_LIR before aggregation.
acceptance: Universal-core gaps are not inflated by GC/JIT implementation-only features.
